subject.title: Plugin `message_sending` hooks silently bypassed on channel agent-reply delivery paths (2026.5.26, still present in 2026.6.1)

question: Which open fix branch should be the canonical repair for this issue's dispatcher and Telegram streamed-final hook bypass?
rationale: Current main still reproduces the bug, but there are several open PRs with different scopes and merge readiness; selecting the permanent safety-hook boundary and branch scope needs maintainer judgment before more automation queues duplicate work.

options.title: Select comprehensive branch after repair
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as the canonical path if its draft/conflict state, duplicate suffix-hook finding, and proof gaps are resolved.

options.title: Land a narrow dispatcher fix first
options.body: Use a smaller dispatcher-only PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92976 for the shared configured-branch bypass while keeping streamed-final coverage tracked separately.

options.title: Ask for a replacement branch
options.body: Close or supersede the current candidates only after a narrower maintainer-owned branch covers both required paths without the existing readiness blockers.

recommendation.title: Select comprehensive branch after repair
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as the canonical path if its draft/conflict state, duplicate suffix-hook finding, and proof gaps are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent main projection work touch both the dispatcher and Telegram lines under review, making this the best available routing candidate from local history.
